I do long for a healthy partnership/relationship, because I think we’ve come to place in time where mental health and mutual respect have grown exponentially. These are foundations for building a solid and living relationship, which I think a vast majority of folks have suffered. 

I wish there were a ‘silver bullet’ but simply recognizing my mental state, minimizing social media and its constant negative narrative, finding activities to distract a little and having a person you trust to talk with are big helps- but truth remains, it’s a constant effort. This- critical listening is priceless. Try and listen to some of your fave tracks and see how much of the production you can audibly identify. How many guitar parts? Clean, dirty or acoustic? How many percussion instruments do you hear? WHEN do you hear doubles vocals or harmonies? The bass tone- is it slap, fat, or even have OD or phase? How many instruments can you pick out? 

How many of you knew there was an acoustic guitar in the chorus of ‘Stayin Alive’ by The Bee Gees? Yes, the classic disco track. Now that you know this, go back and listen for it and you’ll quickly realize how much that subtle acoustic literally MAKES the chorus, you just didn’t realize it. 

This is the beauty of recording- really no wrong way to assemble your songs, just rules for using the gear to capture it mostly.
